content_sections.text: Project Associate - I: M.Sc Bioinformatics / Marine Science (specialization in Biology) / Oceanography (specialization in Biology) / Marine Biology / Marine Biotechnology / Marine Microbiology or equivalent. Experience in handling sample collection in marine habitats, laboratory skills for Microbiology, Molecular biology and Bioinformatic analysis.

To apply directly, use the Apply link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIO to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) for hiring eligible candidates for temporary project roles based in Goa.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIO?
faq.answer: NIO has advertised for the Project Associate - I position under advertisement number GAP003897/3321-26 for various research and laboratory activities.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate - I position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Bioinformatics, Marine Science, Oceanography, Marine Biology, Marine Biotechnology, Marine Microbiology, or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a consolidated monthly salary/stipend of ₹31,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form for the NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is 04 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for the positions through Offline mode by visiting the official website or clicking the provided application links.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for applying to the Project Associate - I positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at the headquarters of the National Institute of Oceanography located in the state of Goa.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification details, guidelines, and application links directly through the official website at https://www.nio.res.in/vacancies/temporary/1894451.
